description: Defines a widget model for map data sources, including functions for testing widget applicability, preparing export info, updating from export info, and retrieving data sources. Contains interfaces and functions related to map layers, data sources, and their configurations within a widget framework.

classes.name: AliasFilterPair
classes.description: Interface representing a pair of optional entity alias and filter information.

classes.name: MapDataLayerDsInfo
classes.description: Interface extending AliasFilterPair with optional additional data source info for map data layers.

classes.name: ExportDataSourceInfo
classes.description: Type representing a mapping from data layer index to MapDataLayerDsInfo.

classes.name: MapDatasourcesInfo
classes.description: Interface representing grouped data source information for various map elements like trips, markers, polygons, circles, and additional data sources.

methods.name: testWidget
methods.description: Checks if a widget is a map widget based on its settings and map type.

methods.name: prepareExportInfo
methods.description: Prepares export data source information from a dashboard and widget configuration.

methods.name: updateFromExportInfo
methods.description: Updates widget settings based on exported data source information, entity aliases, and filters.

methods.name: datasources
methods.description: Retrieves all data sources used by the widget's map layers.

methods.name: hasTimewindow
methods.description: Determines if the widget has a time window based on its data sources.

methods.name: datasourcesHasAggregation
methods.description: Checks if the widget's data sources include aggregation.

methods.name: datasourcesHasOnlyComparisonAggregation
methods.description: Checks if the widget's data sources have only comparison aggregation.
